historical_timing_anchor.scope: H13 public-comparison batch; method and output structure differ from H14
historical_timing_anchor.use: planning anchor only; not an H14 performance measurement

planning_envelope.expected_file_count: approximately 158000 plus progress and summary files
planning_envelope.uncertainty: The preflight uses N=20 and 100 NFE, whereas formal uses N=100 and 10000 NFE. The historical timing anchor uses different benchmark functions. Therefore the envelope is conservative and must be monitored, not treated as a measured completion time.

automatic_or_operator_stop_rules.action: terminate the MATLAB process, retain completed bundles, classify the interrupted run as incomplete, and resume only after review

automatic_or_operator_stop_rules.condition: output exceeds 5 GiB or remaining free space falls below 5 GiB
automatic_or_operator_stop_rules.action: terminate before further runs and preserve all completed bundles
inspect process, license, filesystem and current run; do not change scientific settings; resume unchanged only after root-cause classification

automatic_or_operator_stop_rules.condition: three consecutive failed runs or cumulative failed runs exceed 0.5 percent of attempted runs
automatic_or_operator_stop_rules.action: stop, retain failure bundles and diagnose before any resume

automatic_or_operator_stop_rules.condition: any source hash mismatch, actualNfe not equal to 10000, truthUsedByAlgorithm true, formalPerformanceRun false, NaN or Inf, or declared artifact hash failure
automatic_or_operator_stop_rules.action: immediate scientific stop; no affected output may enter result analysis

resume_policy: Resume only into the identical output directory with unchanged archive, matrix, source manifest, MATLAB release and authorization hashes. Completed hash-valid attempts are reused; incomplete or failed attempts are never overwritten.
analysis_release_gate: Do not call runH14ResultAnalysis until 6720 unique completed formal rows pass coverage, NFE, truth-firewall, finite-value and artifact-integrity audits.
authorization_boundary: This budget does not authorize formal execution. Formal mode remains blocked until the author approves this budget and a separate hash-bound formal authorization and design freeze are created.
